narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the making and raising of the tabernacle; measured, orderly.

the-lord.name: The Lord
the-lord.note: God instructing Moses how to set up and consecrate the tabernacle; calm authority.

1.t: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:

2.t: The first month, the first day of the month, thou shalt set up the tabernacle of the testimony,

3.t: And shalt put the ark in it, and shalt let down the veil before it:

4.t: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set upon it the things that are commanded according to the rite. The candlestick shall stand with its lamps,

5.t: And the altar of gold, whereon the incense is burnt before the ark of the testimony. Thou shalt put the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle,

6.t: And before it the altar of holocaust.

7.t: The laver between the altar and the tabernacle, and thou shalt fill it with water.

8.t: And thou shalt encompass the court with hangings, and the entry thereof.

9.t: And thou shalt take the oil of unction and anoint the tabernacle with its vessels, that they may be sanctified:

10.t: The altar of holocaust and all its vessels:

11.t: The laver with its foot: thou shalt consecrate all with the oil of unction, that they may be most holy.

12.t: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony, and having washed them with water,

13.t: Thou shalt put on them the holy vestments, that they may minister to me, and that the unction of them may prosper to an everlasting priesthood.

14.t: And Moses did all that the Lord had commanded.

15.t: So in the first month of the second year, the first day of the month, the tabernacle was set up.

16.t: And Moses reared it up, and placed the boards and the sockets and the bars, and set up the pillars,

17.t: And spread the roof over the tabernacle, putting over it a cover, as the Lord had commanded.

18.t: And he put the testimony in the ark, thrusting bars underneath, and the oracle above.

19.t: And when he had brought the ark into the tabernacle, he drew the veil before it to fulfil the commandment of the Lord.

20.t: And he set the table in the tabernacle of the testimony, at the north side, without the veil,

21.t: Setting there in order the loaves of proposition, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

22.t: He set the candlestick also in the tabernacle of the testimony, over against the table on the south side,

23.t: Placing the lamps in order, according to the precept of the Lord.

24.t: He set also the altar of gold under the roof of the testimony, over against the veil,

25.t: And burnt upon it the incense of spices, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

26.t: And he put also the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony,

27.t: And the altar of holocaust in the entry of the testimony, offering the holocaust, and the sacrifices upon it, as the Lord had commanded.

28.t: And he set the laver between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar, filling it with water.

29.t: And Moses and Aaron, and his sons, washed their hands and feet,

30.t: When they went into the tabernacle of the covenant, and went to the altar, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

31.t: He set up also the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, drawing the hanging in the entry thereof. After all things were perfected,

32.t: The cloud covered the tabernacle of the testimony, and the glory of the Lord filled it.

33.t: Neither could Moses go into the tabernacle of the covenant, the cloud covering all things, and the majesty of the Lord shining, for the cloud had covered all.

34.t: If at any time the cloud removed from the tabernacle, the children of Israel went forward by their troops:

35.t: If it hung over, they remained in the same place.

36.t: For the cloud of the Lord hung over the tabernacle by day, and a fire by night, in the sight of all the children of Israel throughout all their mansions.
